svg.title: Discovery Engine. Ranks opportunity areas for online fashion shopping from public conversation, with the sampling rule, both taxonomies and the scoring formula printed on screen so every number traces back to the rule that produced it. The business goal: increase the share of users who purchase at least one wishlisted item within 30 days of saving it, with monetary incentives out of scope. It compares several fashion platforms at once (Nykaa Fashion, Myntra, AJIO) and labels 100% of the corpus by published rules. A reel of phrasings from the test suite passes a label line and gets tagged: 'this brand runs small, order one size up' is FIT_SIZE; 'Wish there were customer photos' is FIT_EVIDENCE; 'I keep it in my wishlist and wait for the sale' is PRICE_WAIT; 'Is this suitable for a wedding?' is STYLING_OCCASION; 'Confused between these two kurtas' is COMPARISON; 'Should I buy this? Need opinions please' is SOCIAL_VALIDATION; 'Cheap quality fabric, feels like a first copy' is TRUST_QUALITY; 'My wishlist is a graveyard' is BOOKMARKING; 'the return pickup never came' is LOGISTICS_CX.

div.p: Ranks what stops fashion shoppers from buying, straight from public conversation, with every rule printed on screen.

div.div: The one goal it is built against
div.p: Increase the share of users who buy at least one wishlisted item within 30 days of saving it. Monetary incentives out of scope.
